manifest.label: Synthetic demonstration data

datasets.name: Deterministic synthetic count grids
limitations: No real satellite, WorldPop or OSM observations are represented.
No medical need, occupancy or intervention effect can be inferred.

processing_steps: Simulate eight annual independent count-grid observations
Union nonoverlapping cells; sum count grids; retain sparse clusters for review
Shortest paths over invented walking graph incl connectors
Match candidates to the invented registry and classify mapping/access/combined gaps
limitations: Synthetic demonstration data; no real discovery.
Rank stability is not calibrated predictive confidence.
Priorities are planning assumptions for human investigation.
Local organisations and communities must validate findings.

matching.interpretation: Recorded-settlement proximity in the selected registry only; registry completeness was not verified and an unmatched candidate is not proof of an unknown settlement.

definitions.mapping_gap: Habitation signal not confidently represented in the selected registry
definitions.access_gap: Represented settlement with a modelled journey beyond the demonstrated threshold
definitions.combined_gap: Both conditions may be present; priority for local verification
definitions.none: Registered and within the demonstrated travel-time band
definitions.undetermined: Registry unavailable; only access evidence is reported

gap_classification.note: Thresholds are demonstration parameters, not health standards. Unknown access remains unknown.

feature_definitions.label: mapped road length per square kilometre
fraction of satellite estimate unmatched by OSM

anomaly.preprocessing: log transforms; regional median imputation; 8 missing flags; robust IQR scaling
anomaly.stability_definition: 1 minus standard deviation of seeded percentile ranks / 50; not predictive confidence
anomaly.contributor_definition: Largest absolute feature deviations from regional medians in IQR units, not causal attribution

prioritisation.missing_policy: Unknown access disables overall score. Other missing components contribute no points; original weights retained. Incomplete score is provisional, a lower bound under fixed weights.
prioritisation.sensitivity: Each weight perturbed ±20%, then renormalised; rank agreement is not predictive confidence
prioritisation.purpose: Relative priority for human investigation; not medical risk or probability of unmet need
